import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/project')
from modules import byte_program as bp
from modules.capture_audit import parse_requests, Budget
def check(data, label):
    r,e = parse_requests(bp.literal(data), Budget())
    print(label, '->', ('%d reqs' % len(r)) if r else '', e)
# build a block of an exact size using 8192-byte lines
def block(total):
    """request line 16 bytes + lines + final CRLF(2) == total"""
    budget = total - 16 - 2
    lines = []
    while budget > 0:
        L = min(8192, budget - 2)
        if L < 1: break
        lines.append(b'X:' + b'a'*(L-2) + b'\r\n')
        budget -= L + 2
    data = b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\n' + b''.join(lines) + b'\r\n'
    return data, len(data)
for total in (65534, 65535, 65536, 65537, 65538):
    data, actual = block(total)
    check(data, 'block target %d actual %d' % (total, actual))
EOF
